name: The Seventy-Two Spirits of the Ars Goetia
dom: goetia; the 72 spirits; evocation; the Lesser Key of Solomon
note: The 72 demons catalogued in Johann Weyer's Pseudomonarchia Daemonum (1577) and the Ars Goetia of the Lesser Key of Solomon (Lemegeton, 17th c.), ranked as kings, dukes, princes, marquises, presidents, earls and knights, each commanding legions of spirits.

name: The Infernal Hierarchy (Princes of Hell)
dom: hell; infernal monarchy; princes of darkness
note: The organizing rank-structure of Hell's princes and officers systematized in the early-modern demonological treatises (Weyer 1577; Michaelis 1613; Collin de Plancy, Dictionnaire Infernal 1818) — the court standing above the 72 spirits of the Ars Goetia.

name: The Seven Demons of the Deadly Sins (Binsfeld)
dom: seven deadly sins; pride; greed; lust; envy; gluttony; wrath; sloth
note: Peter Binsfeld's 1589 pairing of each cardinal sin with a presiding demon: Lucifer=pride, Mammon=greed, Asmodeus=lust, Leviathan=envy, Beelzebub=gluttony, Satan=wrath, Belphegor=sloth.

name: Belphegor
dom: sloth; ingenious inventions; wealth through invention; seduction
note: The deadly-sin demon of SLOTH (Binsfeld 1589); in de Plancy a prince who tempts men with ingenious inventions and the promise of ease and riches. Derived from the Moabite/Midianite Baal-Peor (Numbers 25).

name: Adramelech
dom: chancellery; infernal council; the king's wardrobe; deception
note: Great Chancellor of Hell and President of the High Council of Devils, superintendent of the demon-king's wardrobe (de Plancy). Originally a deity of Sepharvaim to whom children were burned (2 Kings 17:31).

name: Bael
dom: invisibility; hidden knowledge; cunning
note: The 1st spirit, a King ruling in the East commanding 66 legions; appears with three heads (toad, man, cat) and makes the conjurer invisible.

name: Agares
dom: languages; runaways; earthquakes; nobility
note: The 2nd spirit, a Duke of the East riding a crocodile, 31 legions; teaches all languages, brings back runaways, causes earthquakes.

name: Vassago
dom: prophecy; finding lost or hidden things
note: The 3rd spirit, a good-natured Prince, 26 legions; declares things past and to come and discovers what is hidden or lost.

name: Samigina (Gamigin)
dom: liberal sciences; souls of the dead
note: The 4th spirit, a Marquis as a small horse or ass, 30 legions; teaches the liberal sciences and gives account of the souls of those who died in sin.

name: Marbas
dom: disease and healing; mechanical arts; transformation; secrets
note: The 5th spirit, a President as a great lion, 36 legions; answers of hidden things, causes and cures diseases, teaches mechanical arts, and changes men into other shapes.

name: Valefor
dom: theft; familiars
note: The 6th spirit, a Duke as a lion with an ass's head, 10 legions; a good familiar who tempts those he serves toward thievery.

name: Amon
dom: prophecy; reconciliation of feuds; procuring love
note: The 7th spirit, a Marquis as a wolf with a serpent's tail (or raven-headed man), 40 legions; tells things past and to come, procures love, reconciles enemies. Name possibly echoes Egyptian Amun or Baal-Hammon (debated).

name: Barbatos
dom: speech of animals; finding treasure; reconciliation; prophecy
note: The 8th spirit, a Duke, 30 legions; gives understanding of the voices of animals, discovers treasures hidden by enchantment, tells things past and to come.

name: Paimon
dom: arts and sciences; hidden knowledge; binding the will; familiars
note: The 9th spirit, a great King obedient to Lucifer riding a camel, 200 legions; teaches all arts, sciences and secret things and binds men to the conjurer's will.

name: Buer
dom: philosophy and logic; herbal medicine; familiars
note: The 10th spirit, a President (wheel-form, Sagittarius), 50 legions; teaches philosophy, logic and the virtues of herbs, and heals all distempers.

name: Gusion
dom: prophecy; reconciliation; honour and dignity
note: The 11th spirit, a Duke (baboon-like), 40 legions; answers things past, present and to come, reconciles friends, gives honour and dignity.

name: Sitri
dom: love and lust; revealing secrets of women
note: The 12th spirit, a Prince with leopard's head and griffin's wings, 60 legions; inflames men and women with love and causes them to reveal themselves wantonly.

name: Beleth
dom: love between man and woman
note: The 13th spirit, a terrible King riding a pale horse with trumpets sounding before him, 85 legions; procures the love of any man or woman.

name: Leraje (Leraie)
dom: war and battles; putrefying wounds
note: The 14th spirit, a Marquis in green clad as an archer, 30 legions; causes great battles and contests and makes arrow-wounds putrefy.

name: Eligos
dom: prophecy of war; discovering hidden things; favour of lords
note: The 15th spirit, a Duke as a goodly knight with lance and serpent, 60 legions; discovers hidden things, knows things to come and of wars, procures the favour of lords and knights.

name: Zepar
dom: love; making women barren
note: The 16th spirit, a Duke in red apparel and armour, 26 legions; makes women love men and brings them together, and can make women barren.

name: Botis
dom: prophecy; reconciliation of friends and foes
note: The 17th spirit, a President and Earl (viper then man with sword), 60 legions; tells things past and to come and reconciles friends and foes.

name: Bathin
dom: virtues of herbs and stones; transportation
note: The 18th spirit, a Duke with serpent's tail on a pale horse, 30 legions; knows the virtues of herbs and stones and transports men suddenly between countries.

name: Sallos
dom: love between man and woman
note: The 19th spirit, a peaceable Duke riding a crocodile with a ducal crown, 30 legions; causes men and women to love one another.

name: Purson
dom: hidden knowledge; finding treasure; prophecy; familiars
note: The 20th spirit, a great King riding a bear with a trumpet, 22 legions; tells things hidden, past, present and to come, discovers treasure, gives good familiars.

name: Marax (Morax)
dom: astronomy and liberal sciences; virtues of herbs and stones; familiars
note: The 21st spirit, an Earl and President as a bull with a man's face, 30 legions; teaches astronomy and the liberal sciences and the virtues of herbs and stones, gives good familiars.

name: Ipos
dom: prophecy; making men witty and bold
note: The 22nd spirit, an Earl and Prince (angel with lion's head, goose's feet, hare's tail), 36 legions; knows things past and to come and makes men witty and bold.

name: Aim (Aym / Haborym)
dom: destruction by fire; cunning; prophecy
note: The 23rd spirit, a Duke with three heads bearing a firebrand, 26 legions; sets cities and great places ablaze, makes men witty, answers truly of private matters.

name: Naberius
dom: rhetoric and the arts; restoring lost dignities
note: The 24th spirit, a Marquis as a black crane, 19 legions; makes men cunning in all arts and sciences, especially rhetoric, and restores lost dignities and honours.

name: Glasya-Labolas
dom: arts and sciences; bloodshed and manslaughter; prophecy; love; invisibility
note: The 25th spirit, a President and Earl as a winged dog, 36 legions; teaches all sciences in an instant, is captain of manslaughter and bloodshed, causes love and grants invisibility.

name: Bune
dom: the dead and graves; riches; wisdom and eloquence; prophecy
note: The 26th spirit, a Duke as a three-headed dragon, 30 legions; changes the place of the dead, makes men rich, wise and eloquent, gives true answers.

name: Ronove
dom: rhetoric and languages; favour of friends and foes; servants
note: The 27th spirit, a Marquis and Earl, 19 legions; teaches rhetoric and the knowledge of tongues, gives good servants and the favour of friends and foes.

name: Berith
dom: prophecy; turning metals to gold; dignities; deception
note: The 28th spirit, a Duke (Beal/Bolfry) as a red soldier on a red horse, 26 legions; gives true answers of past/present/future and turns metals to gold, but is a notorious liar. Also reckoned an officer of Hell's court (Baalberith, keeper of the infernal archives) and derived from the Canaanite Baal-Berith ('lord of the covenant').

name: Astaroth
dom: prophecy; forbidden knowledge; the fall of the spirits; treasures
note: The 29th spirit, a mighty Duke as a foul angel on an infernal dragon, 40 legions; gives true answers of past/present/future, discovers all secrets, teaches the liberal sciences and discourses on the fall of the angels. Also a Grand Duke / Great Prince of Hell (Weyer, de Plancy). A demonized, re-gendered reception of the Canaanite goddess Astarte/Ashtoreth.

name: Forneus
dom: rhetoric and languages; good name; love of friends and foes
note: The 30th spirit, a Marquis as a great sea-monster, 29 legions; teaches rhetoric and languages, gives men a good name, and causes them to be loved by friends and foes.

name: Foras
dom: virtues of herbs and stones; logic and ethics; finding lost things and treasure; invisibility
note: The 31st spirit, a President as a strong man, 29 legions; teaches the virtues of herbs and stones, logic and ethics, finds lost things and treasure, makes men invisible, witty and long-lived.

name: Asmoday
dom: arithmetic, astronomy, geometry, handicrafts; the ring of virtues; treasure; invisibility
note: The 32nd spirit, a great King with three heads on an infernal dragon, 72 legions; gives the ring of virtues, teaches arithmetic, astronomy, geometry and all handicrafts, and guards hidden treasure. The Goetic reception of Asmodeus (Book of Tobit), ultimately the Avestan Aeshma Daeva.

name: Gaap
dom: philosophy and liberal sciences; love or hatred; swift transport; familiars; the books of Amaymon
note: The 33rd spirit, a President and King under Amaymon of the south, 66 legions; teaches philosophy and the liberal sciences, causes love or hatred, carries men swiftly between kingdoms, delivers familiars.

name: Furfur
dom: love; thunder, lightning and storms; revelation of divine things
note: The 34th spirit, an Earl as a winged hart, 26 legions; causes love between man and wife, raises tempests and lightning, and gives true answers of secret and divine things when within a triangle.

name: Marchosias
dom: war; true answers; faithfulness in battle
note: The 35th spirit, a Marquis as a wolf with griffin's wings and serpent's tail, 30 legions; a strong fighter who gives true answers, hoping to return to the Seventh Throne.

name: Stolas
dom: astronomy; virtues of herbs and precious stones
note: The 36th spirit, a Prince as a crowned night-raven/owl, 26 legions; teaches astronomy and the virtues of herbs and precious stones.

name: Phenex
dom: poetry; the sciences; sweet song
note: The 37th spirit, a Marquis as a phoenix singing sweetly, 20 legions; an excellent poet who answers truly of the sciences, hoping to return to the Seventh Throne after 1,200 years.

name: Halphas
dom: war; building towers full of weapons; sending men of war
note: The 38th spirit, an Earl as a stock-dove, 26 legions; builds towers full of weapons and ammunition and sends men of war to appointed places.

name: Malphas
dom: building houses and towers; destroying enemies' works; familiars; deception
note: The 39th spirit, a President as a crow then a man, 40 legions; builds houses and towers, throws down enemies' buildings, reveals their thoughts, gives good familiars, but deceives those who sacrifice to him.

name: Raum
dom: stealing treasure; destroying cities; prophecy; love
note: The 40th spirit, an Earl as a crow then a man, 30 legions; steals treasure from kings' houses, destroys cities and dignities, tells things past and future, reconciles friends and foes.

name: Focalor
dom: drowning men; overthrowing warships; wind and sea
note: The 41st spirit, a Duke as a winged man, 30 legions; drowns men and overturns warships, having power over wind and sea, hoping to return to the Seventh Throne after 1,000 years.

name: Vepar
dom: the waters and warships; storms; death by putrefying wounds
note: The 42nd spirit, a Duke as a mermaid, 29 legions; governs the waters and guides warships, raises storms, and can kill men in three days by putrefying their wounds with worms.

name: Sabnock
dom: building towers and arming them; afflicting wounds; familiars
note: The 43rd spirit, a Marquis as an armed lion-headed soldier on a pale horse, 50 legions; builds towers and castles full of weapons, afflicts men with putrefying wounds, gives good familiars.

name: Shax
dom: taking sight/hearing/understanding; stealing; discovering hidden things; familiars
note: The 44th spirit, a Marquis as a stock-dove, 30 legions; takes away sight, hearing and understanding, steals money and horses, reveals hidden things, but deceives unless bound in a triangle.

name: Vine
dom: discovering witches and hidden things; prophecy; building towers and casting down walls; storms
note: The 45th spirit, a King and Earl as a lion on a black horse bearing a viper, 36 legions; reveals hidden things and witches, tells past and future, builds towers, casts down walls, stirs storms.

name: Bifrons
dom: astrology and geometry; virtues of herbs, stones and woods; the dead
note: The 46th spirit, an Earl, 26 legions; teaches astrology, geometry and the arts and the virtues of herbs and stones, and moves bodies from grave to grave lighting seeming candles upon them.

name: Vual
dom: love of women; prophecy; reconciliation
note: The 47th spirit, a Duke as a dromedary then a man speaking Egyptian, 37 legions; procures the love of women, reconciles friends and foes, tells things past, present and future.

name: Haagenti
dom: wisdom; transmuting metals to gold; turning wine and water
note: The 48th spirit, a President as a winged bull then a man, 33 legions; makes men wise in all things, transmutes metals into gold, and changes wine into water and water into wine.

name: Crocell
dom: geometry and the liberal sciences; hidden things; warming waters
note: The 49th spirit, a Duke, 48 legions; teaches geometry and the liberal sciences, discourses of hidden things, and warms waters producing the appearance of baths.

name: Furcas
dom: philosophy, astronomy, rhetoric, logic; chiromancy and pyromancy
note: The 50th spirit, a Knight, 20 legions; teaches philosophy, astronomy, rhetoric, logic, chiromancy and pyromancy.

name: Balam
dom: prophecy; invisibility; wit
note: The 51st spirit, a terrible King, 40 legions; answers truly of things past, present and to come, gives invisibility and makes men witty.

name: Alloces
dom: astronomy and the liberal sciences; familiars
note: The 52nd spirit, a Duke, 36 legions; teaches astronomy and the liberal sciences and bestows good and faithful familiars.

name: Caim
dom: the voices of birds and animals; prophecy; disputation
note: The 53rd spirit, a President, 30 legions; gives understanding of the voices of birds, oxen, dogs and the sound of waters, and answers truly of things to come.

name: Murmur
dom: the dead; philosophy; necromancy
note: The 54th spirit, a Duke and Earl, 30 legions; teaches philosophy and constrains the souls of the deceased to appear and answer questions.

name: Orobas
dom: prophecy; dignities and favour; protection from deceiving spirits
note: The 55th spirit, a Prince, 20 legions; answers truly of past/present/future and of divinity and creation, gives dignities and favour, and is faithful, not suffering the conjurer to be tempted by any spirit.

name: Gremory
dom: love of women; hidden treasure; prophecy
note: The 56th spirit, a Duke, 26 legions; tells of things past/present/future and of hidden treasures, and procures the love of women young and old.

name: Ose
dom: the liberal sciences; transformation; delusion
note: The 57th spirit, a President, 30 legions; makes one cunning in the liberal sciences, gives true answers of secret things, and can transform a man into any shape or drive him to madness.

name: Amy
dom: astrology and the liberal sciences; hidden treasure; familiars
note: The 58th spirit, a President, 36 legions; teaches astrology and the liberal sciences, gives good familiars, and reveals treasures kept by spirits.

name: Orias
dom: astrology and the stars; dignities; transformation
note: The 59th spirit, a Marquis, 30 legions; teaches the virtues of the stars and the mansions of the planets, gives dignities and the favour of friends and foes, and transforms men.

name: Vapula
dom: handicrafts, professions, philosophy and sciences
note: The 60th spirit, a Duke, 36 legions; makes men knowing in handicrafts, professions, philosophy and other sciences.

name: Zagan
dom: transmutation of liquids and metals; wit
note: The 61st spirit, a King and President, 33 legions; makes men witty, turns wine to water and water to wine, blood to wine and metal to coin, and makes fools wise.

name: Volac
dom: hidden treasure; knowledge of serpents
note: The 62nd spirit, a President (Ualac/Valak), 38 legions; gives true answers of hidden treasures and reveals where serpents may be found, delivering them harmless to the magician.

name: Andras
dom: war; death; sowing discord
note: The 63rd spirit, a Marquis, 30 legions; sows discord and will slay the master, servants and assistants if the conjurer is not wary.

name: Haures (Flauros)
dom: prophecy and the fall of spirits; destroying enemies by fire; protection
note: The 64th spirit, a Duke (Flauros), 36 legions; answers truly of past/present/future, of divinity and the fall of spirits, destroys the conjurer's enemies by fire and guards against other spirits.

name: Andrealphus
dom: geometry and astronomy; subtle reasoning; transformation into a bird
note: The 65th spirit, a Marquis, 30 legions; teaches geometry, measurement and astronomy, makes men subtle in reasoning, and can transform a man into the likeness of a bird.

name: Cimejes (Kimaris)
dom: grammar, logic, rhetoric; hidden treasure; the spirits of Africa
note: The 66th spirit, a Marquis (Kimaris), 20 legions; rules the spirits of Africa, teaches grammar, logic and rhetoric, discovers lost or hidden things and buried treasure, and makes excellent warriors.

name: Amdusias
dom: music; command of trees; familiars
note: The 67th spirit, a Duke (Amdukias), 29 legions; causes unseen trumpets and musical instruments to be heard and bends trees at the conjurer's will, giving excellent familiars.

name: Belial (Goetia)
dom: dignities; favour of friends and foes; familiars
note: The 68th spirit, a mighty King created next after Lucifer, 80 legions; distributes preferments and dignities, gives the favour of friends and foes, and requires offerings to answer truly. The Goetic reception of the biblical/Second-Temple Belial.

name: Decarabia
dom: virtues of birds and precious stones; command of birds
note: The 69th spirit, a Marquis, 30 legions; discovers the virtues of birds and precious stones and makes the likeness of birds fly before the conjurer as familiars.

name: Seere
dom: swift transport; abundance; discovering theft and hidden treasure
note: The 70th spirit, a Prince under Amaymon, 26 legions; good-natured, goes and returns in the twinkling of an eye, brings abundance, discovers thefts and hidden treasure.

name: Dantalion
dom: all arts and sciences; reading and changing thoughts; love
note: The 71st spirit, a Duke, 36 legions; teaches all arts and sciences, declares the secret counsel of any person, reads and changes thoughts, and causes love, showing the likeness of any person.

name: Andromalius
dom: punishing thieves and wickedness; recovering stolen goods; hidden treasure
note: The 72nd and last spirit, an Earl, 36 legions; brings back thieves and stolen goods, discovers wickedness and underhand dealing, punishes thieves, and reveals hidden treasures.
